test_title: PYST 53: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 9th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Millions of people / have been protected / from polio by a fluid / called as a vaccine.
solution:
The correct answer is **called as a vaccine**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The fourth part of the sentence contains a grammatical error.
 
• The correct form would be **called a vaccine**.
 
• **'called as a vaccine'** is not appropriate for this particular sentence because here the sentence implies that millions of people are protected from polio by a fluid **which is called a vaccine**. 
 
• The name of the particular fluid is vaccine so we can say that the fluid is **called a vaccine**.
 
• Writing '**called a vaccine'** solves the purpose of the sentence and the meaning of the sentence can easily be understood.
 
• **'Called'** here is a verb form that can be used instead of '**named'** or '**known as'**.
 
• It can be used with '**as'** when the meaning shows '**was selected to be'. **
 
 
• *Example- He was **called as** a manager in the year 2001*.
 
 
 
• **'Called as'** can be used in a sentence when it refers to somebody who has called you over the telephone.
 
 
• *Example- I just **called you up as** a wellwisher, not as a teacher*.
